_readme: CareerNexus — Team VertexSquad.
THIS IS THE FILE TO EDIT to change the Team section. Add, remove or
update a member here and the page follows. Nothing is hard-coded.
HOW THE NAMES GOT HERE: every person listed is a real contributor to
this repository, taken from git commit history. Nobody was invented.
Run `git shortlog -sne --all` to see the same list.
FIELDS LEFT EMPTY ARE DELIBERATE. role, bio, photo, linkedin and some
github handles are blank because they are not recorded anywhere in the
project, and guessing them would put made-up facts on a public page.
Fill them in yourself — the page shows a field only when it has a
value, so a half-filled entry still looks intentional rather than
broken.
TO FILL IN A MEMBER:
role      a short job title, e.g. "Backend & API"
bio       one or two sentences, max ~200 characters
photo     a path under assets/, e.g. "assets/team/sneha.jpg".
Leave blank and the page draws initials instead.
skills    a list of strings, e.g. ["Python", "FastAPI"]
linkedin  full https:// profile URL
github    full https:// profile URL
PERSONAL EMAIL ADDRESSES ARE NOT LISTED HERE ON PURPOSE. The commit
history contains each contributor's email, but publishing someone's
personal address on a public web page is their decision to make, not
the project's. Everyone reaches the team through the contact form,
which goes to the single address in CONTACT_TO (backend/.env).
The `contribution` lines below are facts from git history, not job
titles. Replace them with whatever the person prefers.
